title: Dozens of Resumes, One Call From an Old Colleague
why_read: A personal essay about job hunting after 15 years in QA, offering little technical content beyond commentary on AI's role in modern work.
analysis: This is a personal narrative about the emotional experience of job searching after leaving a QA position, touching briefly on using AI tools for efficiency but without technical depth or specifics. It reads as a career reflection piece rather than an engineering article, more suited to a general career blog than a technical digest. There's minimal transferable technical insight here.
